mission: SEC-001 PR 1 (R13), owner-approved plan cardpirate/engineer/2026-11-15-sec-001-plan.md (approval t478u, content-pipeline 2ef7f18; wording revised with CP security's recheck b119fab in f26e687): new diagnostics run without a workflow edit (the diagnostic input becomes free text gated by diagnostic.load()); a bounded print_ids input bound as a SQL parameter; a diagnostic SQL lint that refuses functions running a query given as text, regclass/regproc casts, escape, Unicode and dollar-quoted literals and block comments, and user-data tables or credential columns, because results land in public Actions logs. The lint is not a control; the SELECT-only database role (first mission after SEC-001) is. The ops-readonly.yml change is the owner's to add on this branch (exact diff in the PR description). RED (security_or_secrets_policy), owner merges by hand.

impacts.reason: Diagnostic lint and the bounded print_ids input in the read-only ops runner. market-value-membership.sql writes its newline separator as chr(10) instead of an escape literal (same string).
One refused case per lint item, every shipped .sql file still parses, print_ids parsing and binding; the workflow test asserts the free-text diagnostic and print_ids inputs.
Adding a diagnostic no longer needs a workflow line; lint and print_ids documented.

routes: No new route. No source request.
dependencies: owner adds the ops-readonly.yml diff on this branch
impact.deployment_impact: None at runtime: scripts/ops runs only in the ops workflows. No collector, API or web change, no collector rollout, no migration.

recovery.procedure: Native revert PR with its own mission file.
recovery.trigger: A shipped diagnostic refused by the lint, or db-diagnostic failing on a valid name.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema change and no row written.

verification.observation_window: After the owner merges: one db-diagnostic run of work-by-state (read-only) and CP security's retest of the code.
